findings.issue: Hebrew 3fs suffix on בָהּ (antecedent הָעֲבֹדָה) rendered as masculine él to agree with Spanish servicio; same referent, grammatical gender smoothing only.
Construct בְּדִבְרֵי rendered with a before palabras (mirar a) instead of en; Spanish verb government, not a meaning shift.

notes: Tokens license: let the service be heavy on the men; they do/work in it; let them not regard words of falsehood.
